## What's Changed

- Fixed a startup deadlock where the restart leak-protection firewall blocked Ackwrap's own rule-set downloads before sing-box could become ready.
- Kept controlled downloads and their DNS queries reachable through the existing marked-socket bypass without opening unrelated router or protected-device traffic.
- Used configured WAN/system DNS upstreams for controlled downloads so startup no longer depends on a local resolver backed by the stopped core. Existing proxy and download-acceleration settings are preserved.
- Added isolated firewall regression coverage for IPv4/IPv6 downloads, UDP/TCP DNS, an empty Geo rule-set cache, and download failures that must leave protection in place.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/ackwrap/ackrun/compare/v1.0.8...v1.0.9
